<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state(f):
    P=O=None; C=[]
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        b=n['boundary']; r0=min(p[0] for p in b); c0=min(p[1] for p in b)
        if n['color']=='N': P=(r0,c0)
        elif n['color']=='O': O=(r0,c0)
        elif n['color'] in ('c','G','B') and 10<=n['pixels']<=18: C.append((r0,c0,n['color']))
    return P,O,sorted(C)
print("start",state(current_frame))
for i in range(6):
    action(['RIGHT'],intent='explore')
    print("after RIGHT",i+1,state(current_frame))
    if last_action_result.get('no_impact') or last_action_result.get('level_completed'): print("  stop"); break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
